attacks.name: Scarlet Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Elusive|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Impact Webbing
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 2 or less, this character may Push it Away |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Whatever a Spider Can
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance |!movement_medium|.

|!wild| |*Catch!|: After this attack is resolved, this character may choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 2 or less within |!range| 3 of this character and destroy it. The defender suffers a collision as if the terrain feature were Thrown into it.

superPowers.name: Web Whip
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 and in LOS, and Push it Toward this character |!movement_small|. Then Place this character within |!range| 1 of the enemy character. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Proportionate Strength of a Spider
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!movement_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Spider-Sense
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against an |!physical| or |!energy| attack or making a dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.
